records.context: **CORUM % and KEGG %**, the share of clusters with at least one enriched group: a two-sided Fisher exact test for every group in every cluster, Benjamini-Hochberg within the cluster, enriched at FDR < 0.05. The background is every clustered row, non-targeting rows included. Two variants are reported: ``may2025`` counts every member of a group (Brieflow's release of May 2025, which reproduces Funk et al.'s 24.3 % and 13.5 %) and ``head`` only the members in the background (Brieflow's current code).

records.source: **CORUM % and KEGG %**, the share of clusters with at least one enriched group: a two-sided Fisher exact test for every group in every cluster, Benjamini-Hochberg within the cluster, enriched at FDR < 0.05. Two variants are reported: ``may2025`` counts every member of a group (Brieflow's release of May 2025, which reproduces Funk et al.'s 24.3 % and 13.5 %) and ``head`` only the members in the background (Brieflow's current code).
records.translation: **CORUM % 및 KEGG %**: 농축된 그룹이 하나 이상 있는 클러스터의 비율입니다. 모든 클러스터의 모든 그룹에 대해 양측 Fisher 정확 검정을 하고, 클러스터 안에서 Benjamini-Hochberg 보정을 하며, FDR < 0.05이면 농축된 것으로 봅니다. 배경은 클러스터링된 모든 행이며 비표적 행도 포함됩니다. 두 가지 변형을 보고합니다. ``may2025`` 는 그룹의 모든 구성원을 셉니다(Brieflow의 2025년 5월 릴리스로, Funk et al.의 24.3 %와 13.5 %를 재현합니다). ``head`` 는 배경에 있는 구성원만 셉니다(Brieflow의 현재 코드).

records.translation: TVN은 세포별 특징을, 모든 배치의 비표적(대조군) 세포가 모든 방향으로 같은 퍼짐을 갖는 성분으로 바꿉니다. 이는 Brieflow의 프로파일 정규화입니다(``workflow/lib/aggregate/align.py``, Cheeseman 연구실, copyright 2025 Massachusetts Institute of Technology, MIT 라이선스). 여기의 함수들은 그 ``centerscale_by_batch``, ``embed_by_pca``, ``tvn_on_controls`` 단계를 새로 다시 구현한 것으로, 결과를 원본과 값 하나하나 대조할 수 있도록 작성되었습니다.

records.context: The steps, with the batch being the microplate sample position:
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#2
records.source: The steps, with the batch being the well:
records.translation: 배치를 웰로 둘 때의 단계는 다음과 같습니다.

records.context: 1. columns with more than ``max_nonfinite`` non-finite values are dropped and the remaining gaps are filled with the column median; 2. every batch is centred and scaled on all of its cells; 3. a PCA keeping ``pca_variance`` of the variance is fitted on a random sample of ``pca_sample`` cells (seed ``seed``) and every cell is projected; 4. the projection is centred and scaled on the control cells, rotated onto the principal axes of the control cells, and every axis is scaled to unit variance on the control cells of each batch (the whitening); 5. CORAL aligns the control covariance of every batch to the pooled one (both regularised by ``coral_ridge`` times the identity).
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#3
records.source: 1. columns with more than ``max_nonfinite`` non-finite values are dropped and the remaining gaps are filled with the column median; 2. every batch is centred and scaled on all of its cells; 3. a PCA keeping ``pca_variance`` of the variance is fitted on a random sample of ``pca_sample`` cells (seed ``seed``) and every cell is projected; 4. the projection is centred and scaled on the control cells, rotated onto the principal axes of the control cells, and every axis is scaled to unit variance on the control cells of each batch (the whitening); 5. CORAL aligns the control covariance of every batch to the pooled one (both regularised by ``coral_ridge`` times the identity).
records.translation: 1. 유한하지 않은 값이 ``max_nonfinite`` 개보다 많은 열은 제외하고 남은 빈칸은 열 중앙값으로 채웁니다. 2. 모든 배치를 그 배치의 모든 세포에서 중심 맞춤하고 스케일링합니다. 3. 분산의 ``pca_variance`` 를 유지하는 PCA를 무작위로 뽑은 ``pca_sample`` 개 세포(시드 ``seed``)에 적합하고 모든 세포를 투영합니다. 4. 투영 결과를 대조군 세포에서 중심 맞춤하고 스케일링한 뒤 대조군 세포의 주축으로 회전하고, 각 배치의 대조군 세포에서 모든 축을 단위 분산으로 스케일링합니다(백색화). 5. CORAL이 모든 배치의 대조군 공분산을 통합 공분산에 정렬합니다(둘 다 ``coral_ridge`` 곱하기 단위 행렬로 정규화).

records.context: Two implementations are given. :func:`tvn_in_memory` holds every cell at once, as Brieflow does. :func:`fit_tvn_streamed` reads one batch at a time and keeps only the control cells and a PCA sample, so a laboratory microplate or a pool of laboratory microplates never sits in memory; :meth:`TVNModel.transform` then applies the fitted model batch by batch.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#4
records.source: Two implementations are given. :func:`tvn_in_memory` holds every cell at once, as Brieflow does. :func:`fit_tvn_streamed` reads one batch at a time and keeps only the control cells and a PCA sample, so a plate or a pool of plates never sits in memory; :meth:`TVNModel.transform` then applies the fitted model batch by batch.
records.translation: 두 가지 구현이 제공됩니다. :func:`tvn_in_memory` 는 Brieflow처럼 모든 세포를 한꺼번에 메모리에 둡니다. :func:`fit_tvn_streamed` 는 배치를 하나씩 읽고 대조군 세포와 PCA 표본만 유지하므로, 플레이트 하나나 여러 플레이트를 합친 데이터가 메모리에 올라가지 않습니다. 이후 :meth:`TVNModel.transform` 이 적합된 모델을 배치별로 적용합니다.

records.context: The whitening makes the low-variance tail sensitive to the PCA fit sample. Step 4 divides every axis by its control spread, so an axis that holds almost no control variance is blown up to the same weight as the first one. Which weak directions survive step 3 depends on the cells in the PCA sample, so two fits that differ only in that sample (or in the order the batches are read) agree on the strong axes but not on the tail. On laboratory microplate A of Funk et al. 2022 the in-memory and the streamed fits give gene-pair cosines that correlate at only r = 0.82, while their string auprc is the same. ``whiten_epsilon`` is added to every axis's control variance at both scaling steps (``x / sqrt(var + epsilon)`` instead of ``x / sqrt(var)``), which shrinks the weak axes: at 3, the default, the two fits correlate at r = 0.93 and the string auprc is at or above Brieflow's. ``whiten_epsilon=0`` is Brieflow's TVN exactly, the setting that reproduces the laboratory microplate A pilot. ``components`` keeps only the leading control axes; it did not help on laboratory microplate A and is off by default.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#5
records.source: THE WHITENING MAKES THE LOW-VARIANCE TAIL SENSITIVE TO THE PCA FIT SAMPLE. Step 4 divides every axis by its control spread, so an axis that holds almost no control variance is blown up to the same weight as the first one. Which weak directions survive step 3 depends on the cells in the PCA sample, so two fits that differ only in that sample (or in the order the batches are read) agree on the strong axes but not on the tail. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the in-memory and the streamed fits give gene-pair cosines that correlate at only r = 0.82, while their STRING AUPRC is the same. ``whiten_epsilon`` is added to every axis's control variance at both scaling steps (``x / sqrt(var + epsilon)`` instead of ``x / sqrt(var)``), which shrinks the weak axes: at 3, the default, the two fits correlate at r = 0.93 and the STRING AUPRC is at or above Brieflow's. ``whiten_epsilon=0`` is Brieflow's TVN exactly, the setting that reproduces the plate A pilot. ``components`` keeps only the leading control axes; it did not help on plate A and is off by default.
records.translation: 백색화는 낮은 분산 꼬리를 PCA 적합 표본에 민감하게 만듭니다. 4단계는 모든 축을 그 대조군 퍼짐으로 나누므로, 대조군 분산을 거의 담지 않은 축도 첫 번째 축과 같은 무게로 부풀려집니다. 어떤 약한 방향이 3단계에서 살아남는지는 PCA 표본의 세포에 달려 있으므로, 그 표본(또는 배치를 읽는 순서)만 다른 두 적합은 강한 축에서는 일치하지만 꼬리에서는 일치하지 않습니다. Funk et al. 2022의 plate A에서 in-memory 적합과 streamed 적합이 주는 유전자 쌍 코사인은 r = 0.82로만 상관되지만, STRING AUPRC는 같습니다. ``whiten_epsilon`` 은 두 스케일링 단계 모두에서 각 축의 대조군 분산에 더해지며(``x / sqrt(var + epsilon)`` 을 ``x / sqrt(var)`` 대신 사용), 약한 축을 줄여 줍니다. 기본값인 3에서는 두 적합이 r = 0.93으로 상관되고 STRING AUPRC는 Brieflow와 같거나 더 높습니다. ``whiten_epsilon=0`` 은 Brieflow의 TVN과 정확히 같으며, plate A 파일럿을 재현하는 설정입니다. ``components`` 는 상위 대조군 축만 유지하며, plate A에서는 도움이 되지 않았고 기본적으로 꺼져 있습니다.

records.context: This is the cell-level TVN of an optical pooled screening experiment. :func:`spacr.batch_correction.spherize_features` is the sphering of microplate sample position-level profiles that pycytominer calls TVN; it is a different step.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn#6
